My dear [Christabel](/person/329)
Thank you much for Giftie. She looks very pretty and I like her picture. Yes, we will, if we can, have a Christmas [Barnacle](/periodical/89). I have one capitally illustrated paper for it already from [Sparrow Hawk](/person/97).
Shall we send out the Questions for December, or January, I mean shall they go New Years day, or the month before?
I think we are to have a new [Gosling](/topic/104) -
[Emma Butler](/person/822)
Wantage Vicarage
Berks.
Would you send her the rules, and the names, omitting alas [Turkscap](/person/1520), who has grown too busy. Have you seen her pretty story, ‘Nigel Bartram’s Ideal’ a shilling book of Warne’s

yours affectionately

C M Yonge
